inference_endpoints.purpose: Primary chat completions endpoint. Routes requests to model_list entries by model_name. THE main inference endpoint used by all clients.
inference_endpoints.request_shape_summary: {model, messages[], stream?, temperature?, max_tokens?, tools?, tool_choice?, response_format?, user?, metadata?, guardrails?}. The 'model' field maps to model_name in config.yaml (NOT litellm_params.model).
inference_endpoints.response_shape_summary: OpenAI ChatCompletion object, or SSE stream of ChatCompletionChunk when stream=true.
inference_endpoints.model_alias_behavior: model field = config.yaml model_name (e.g. 'coding', 'coding.pro'). LiteLLM routes to the primary litellm_params.model and falls back per router_settings.fallbacks. Provider-specific model strings are never sent by clients.
inference_endpoints.streaming_behavior: SSE chunked stream when stream=true. stream_timeout configurable (workestrator: 300s). Non-stream returns full ChatCompletion JSON.
inference_endpoints.pass_through_behavior: drop_params=true drops unsupported provider params. Input/output/exceptions mapped to OpenAI format for all providers. Anthropic providers (kimi/minimax) translated via anthropic/ prefix.

inference_endpoints.purpose: Legacy text completions endpoint (OpenAI /v1/completions).
inference_endpoints.response_shape_summary: OpenAI TextCompletion object or SSE stream chunks.
inference_endpoints.model_alias_behavior: model field maps to config model_name, same aliasing as /v1/chat/completions.
inference_endpoints.pass_through_behavior: drop_params applies. Mapped to OpenAI format.

inference_endpoints.purpose: Text embeddings endpoint (OpenAI /v1/embeddings).
inference_endpoints.response_shape_summary: OpenAI Embedding object with embedding vectors.
inference_endpoints.model_alias_behavior: model field maps to config model_name.
inference_endpoints.pass_through_behavior: Mapped to OpenAI format.

inference_endpoints.purpose: Content moderation endpoint (OpenAI /v1/moderations).
inference_endpoints.response_shape_summary: OpenAI Moderation object with category scores.
inference_endpoints.model_alias_behavior: model field maps to config model_name.
inference_endpoints.pass_through_behavior: Mapped to OpenAI format.

inference_endpoints.purpose: Image generation endpoint (OpenAI /v1/images/generations).
inference_endpoints.response_shape_summary: OpenAI Image object with b64_json or url.
inference_endpoints.model_alias_behavior: model field maps to config model_name.
inference_endpoints.pass_through_behavior: Mapped to OpenAI format.

inference_endpoints.purpose: Audio transcription endpoint (OpenAI Whisper /v1/audio/transcriptions).
inference_endpoints.response_shape_summary: Transcription text / verbose JSON.
inference_endpoints.model_alias_behavior: model field maps to config model_name.
inference_endpoints.pass_through_behavior: Mapped to OpenAI format.

inference_endpoints.purpose: Text-to-speech endpoint (OpenAI /v1/audio/speech).
inference_endpoints.response_shape_summary: Binary audio stream (mp3/opus/aac/flac).
inference_endpoints.model_alias_behavior: model field maps to config model_name.
inference_endpoints.pass_through_behavior: Mapped to OpenAI format.

inference_endpoints.purpose: OpenAI Responses API endpoint. Also the entry point for MCP tool consumption via server_url='litellm_proxy'.
inference_endpoints.request_shape_summary: {model, input, stream?, tools?, instructions?, ...}. MCP tools consumed when server_url='litellm_proxy'.
inference_endpoints.response_shape_summary: Response object or streamed response events.
inference_endpoints.model_alias_behavior: model field maps to config model_name.
inference_endpoints.pass_through_behavior: Mapped to OpenAI Responses format. MCP tools routed to configured mcp_servers.

inference_endpoints.purpose: Anthropic Messages API passthrough (beta). Native Anthropic protocol for Anthropic-protocol providers (kimi, minimax).
inference_endpoints.request_shape_summary: {model, messages[], max_tokens, system?, stream?, tools?, ...} in Anthropic format.
inference_endpoints.response_shape_summary: Anthropic Message object or SSE stream of Anthropic events.
inference_endpoints.model_alias_behavior: model field maps to config model_name. anthropic/ provider prefix selects Anthropic protocol translation.
inference_endpoints.streaming_behavior: SSE stream of Anthropic-format events (message_start, content_block_delta, etc.) when stream=true.
inference_endpoints.pass_through_behavior: Native Anthropic protocol preserved. Guardrails unified path applies on /v1/messages and /v1/chat/completions.

inference_endpoints.purpose: Batch API — create batch job (OpenAI /v1/batches).
inference_endpoints.response_shape_summary: OpenAI Batch object.
inference_endpoints.model_alias_behavior: model resolved within batch input file; maps to config model_name.
inference_endpoints.pass_through_behavior: Mapped to OpenAI format.

inference_endpoints.purpose: File upload/management endpoint (OpenAI /v1/files). Used by batches, fine-tuning, assistants.
inference_endpoints.response_shape_summary: OpenAI File object.
inference_endpoints.model_alias_behavior: Not model-specific.
inference_endpoints.pass_through_behavior: Mapped to OpenAI format.

inference_endpoints.purpose: List available models (OpenAI /v1/models). Returns configured model_name entries. Supports include_metadata and fallback_type query params.
inference_endpoints.response_shape_summary: OpenAI Model list with id=model_name for each configured model.
inference_endpoints.model_alias_behavior: Returns model_name entries from config.yaml (the client-facing aliases).
inference_endpoints.pass_through_behavior: Static config read; works without DB.

inference_endpoints.purpose: Direct REST API to list MCP tools without an LLM call. Operates on config-defined mcp_servers.
inference_endpoints.response_shape_summary: List of MCP tools (namespaced by server name).
inference_endpoints.model_alias_behavior: Not model-specific. MCP aliases (litellm_settings.mcp_aliases) map alias->server.
inference_endpoints.pass_through_behavior: Reads configured mcp_servers (config.yaml). Works without DB for config-defined servers.

inference_endpoints.purpose: Direct REST API to invoke an MCP tool without an LLM call.
inference_endpoints.response_shape_summary: MCP tool call result.
inference_endpoints.model_alias_behavior: Not model-specific.
inference_endpoints.pass_through_behavior: Routes to configured mcp_servers. Works without DB for config-defined servers.

inference_endpoints.purpose: Anthropic Skills API. CRUD for reusable AI skills (SKILL.md + assets as ZIP). Requires ?beta=true and anthropic-beta: skills-2025-10-02 header.
inference_endpoints.request_shape_summary: POST: multipart (ZIP or SKILL.md). GET: list with limit. Headers: X-Api-Key, anthropic-version: 2023-06-01, anthropic-beta: skills-2025-10-02.
inference_endpoints.response_shape_summary: Skill object(s) with id, name, description.
inference_endpoints.model_alias_behavior: Optional model param selects configured anthropic model/credentials for multi-account routing.
inference_endpoints.pass_through_behavior: Follows Anthropic Skills API spec. DB requirement not documented on source page (storage backend unconfirmed).

inference_endpoints.purpose: A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol gateway. JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint accepting message/send, message/stream, tasks/*, agent/getAuthenticatedExtendedCard. Routes to config-defined agents.
inference_endpoints.request_shape_summary: JSON-RPC 2.0: {jsonrpc, method, params, id}. Headers: Authorization, a2a-version, X-LiteLLM-Trace-Id.
inference_endpoints.response_shape_summary: JSON-RPC 2.0 result/error. Streaming via message/stream uses SSE statusUpdate/artifactUpdate events.
inference_endpoints.model_alias_behavior: Not model-specific. agent_id maps to agents[] config block agent_name.
inference_endpoints.streaming_behavior: message/stream returns SSE events (statusUpdate/artifactUpdate). protocolVersion 0.3 or 1.0.
inference_endpoints.pass_through_behavior: message/send and message/stream go through LiteLLM A2A client (logging, guardrails, spend). Other methods forwarded to upstream agent URL unchanged.

inference_endpoints.purpose: Model connectivity health check. Makes actual API calls to configured models to verify reachability.
inference_endpoints.response_shape_summary: Per-model health status (healthy/unhealthy with error detail).
inference_endpoints.model_alias_behavior: Checks all configured model_name entries.
inference_endpoints.pass_through_behavior: Works without DB (in-memory). Makes real provider calls.

inference_endpoints.purpose: Liveness probe. Returns 200 if the proxy process is alive. (Note: both /health/liveness and /health/liveliness exist in the OpenAPI — the misspelled variant is the one used by workestrator infra.)
inference_endpoints.response_shape_summary: 200 OK (liveness).
inference_endpoints.model_alias_behavior: Not applicable.
inference_endpoints.pass_through_behavior: Works without DB. Used as Kubernetes liveness probe.

inference_endpoints.purpose: Readiness probe. Includes DB connection status. Returns ready when the proxy can serve requests.
inference_endpoints.response_shape_summary: Readiness status including DB connectivity (DB status is N/A in in-memory deployment).
inference_endpoints.model_alias_behavior: Not applicable.
inference_endpoints.pass_through_behavior: Works without DB (DB status reported as not-connected/N/A). Used as Kubernetes readiness probe.

inference_endpoints.purpose: Prometheus metrics scrape endpoint. Exposes litellm_* metrics for request counting, latency, provider status, fallbacks. NOT present in the OpenAPI inventory (it is a Prometheus exposition endpoint, not a FastAPI OpenAPI route).
inference_endpoints.response_shape_summary: Prometheus text exposition format (litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric, litellm_llm_api_requests_metric, etc.).
inference_endpoints.model_alias_behavior: Metrics labeled by requested_model, model_group, hashed_api_key.
inference_endpoints.pass_through_behavior: Works without DB and without Redis for basic metrics. Requires litellm_settings.callbacks: ['prometheus']. Budget/rate-limit metrics require DB-backed virtual keys. require_auth_for_metrics_endpoint can enable master_key auth.

management_endpoints_summary: Management endpoints (544 operations across 92 tags) are enumerated in openapi-management-endpoints.index.json, organized by tag/family with requires_db flags inferred from path semantics. The workestrator runs LiteLLM in-memory (no Postgres), so management endpoints that mutate or query virtual keys, teams, users, budgets, or spend are unavailable. See openapi-management-endpoints.index.json for the full high-value family index.

notes.metrics_endpoint_caveat: GET /metrics is a Prometheus scrape endpoint and is NOT present in the OpenAPI inventory (openapi_route_inventory.json). It is sourced from the Prometheus docs page. It works without a database.
notes.health_liveliness_typo: Both /health/liveness and /health/liveliness (misspelled) exist in the OpenAPI. The workestrator infra uses /health/liveliness and /health/readiness.
notes.anti_hallucination: Every path/method traces to either p0-supported_endpoints.md or openapi_route_inventory.json. operationId and tag fields are verbatim from the OpenAPI inventory. requires_db is inferred from path semantics.
